evidence.mission_note: A manual, RWD, Nissan-reliable coupe that fits the enthusiast bridge brief and should resell easily. The low-mile premium buys collectibility rather than freedom from age-based service.
evidence.rationale: The listing establishes identity well: the VIN decodes as a 2008 G37 coupe, and photos confirm the six-speed manual, G37S Sport hardware and K57 paint. One owner, a clean Oregon title, a Carfax and service records are stated, but none of that documentation was captured here. Observed items are the Stillen intakes and aftermarket exhaust, which need a CARB EO or the included stock parts for CA registration, and recall 08V521000, whose completion is undocumented. Photos show a very clean car, including a dry-looking rear underside. Every model-critical item remains open: oil gallery and pressure health, OBD scan, clutch hydraulics, recall status and front underside leaks. At 8k miles over 18 years, age-based seal, fluid and tire concerns apply regardless of mileage. The current bid of $15,000 is not a clearing price, and the auction closes 2026-10-15, leaving little time for inspection.
evidence.next_action: Before the 2026-10-15 close, message the seller via BaT for the service records, tire date codes and recall status, and ask whether a Bend-area shop can do a hot-oil-pressure and scan check before bidding.
